name: keepkeys
description: Store secrets in a native OS vault from the host or a private Tailscale phone page, then approve each agent command.

interface.shortDescription: Local secrets for approved agent commands
interface.longDescription: KeepKeys lets the agent prepare names, variables, descriptions, providers, and official documentation links. At the host, press Paste & Store to put the clipboard value into the operating-system vault. From a phone, use a ten-minute Tailscale Serve page that never opens to the public internet. Then approve each command that may use the key. Secret values are never returned to the model.
capabilities: Private phone intake with Tailscale Serve
Native macOS, Windows, and Linux vaults
defaultPrompt: Store a new secret with KeepKeys.
